macro_accuracy.description: Points based on avg % deviation from target macros. Widened for raw-ingredient model where LLM portion estimation is approximate.

plate_composition.description: Points for each food category present (protein + carb + fat + veg)

culinary_coherence.description: Matches archetype slots + pairings are culturally valid

micro_diversity.description: Count of distinct food groups in the meal

goal_alignment.description: Priority macro for user's goal is prominent in the meal

practicality.description: Reasonable portion sizes. Min=1g since raw spices are naturally 1-5g.
